title: Release notes in the app, trade unit overlap on saved lists
summary: A short note on what changed after each release, and a way to spot producers a saved list is hiding.

items.text: After each release the app tells you what changed. The notice appears once, and you can reopen it any time from the What's New row in your profile menu.
Your profile menu now shows which release and build you are running. Include that line when you report a problem and we can tell exactly which version you were on.
A saved list now shows which of its producers fall outside your current trade unit selection, so you can see at a glance why a list looks shorter than you expected.
The activity status column no longer shows stale values for originators who have signed in recently.
